company.shortDescription: Bild AI is an AI based Internet firm offering comprehends construction blueprints, material automation and cost estimation for builders.
company.description: Bild AI utilizes artificial intelligence to interpret construction blueprints and extract essential material and cost information for builders, and traditionally, obtaining material and cost estimates from blueprints is a labor-intensive task that requires manual drawing and is susceptible to human error, and this method can be both time-consuming and costly, potentially leading to significant financial losses on projects.
